Exact source and nearest detail show short swept brown side-part hair and independent brows, serious single mouth, smooth upper lip/chin, no eyewear or hat, dark olive standing-collar tunic with screen-left gold shoulder detail, grey-green photographic backing, tilted dark frame and overlapping pale note with two compact upper mark rows. Raw preserves these visible features with the yellow mascot/green-ringed eyes. Unlike the prior job finding of a tall narrowing yellow neck with an inward notch, the current rounded lower head directly meets the wide continuous standing collar: no neck column, floating collar, cream patch or cloth penetration is visible. Pose/crop/light and single mouth remain coherent. Tiny shoulder/fastener linework and individual note glyphs cannot be read from the exact source; their precise symbols are not proved or claimed, and this evidence limit alone does not prevent approval under visible-source-differences-v1. The actual two upper mark groups and otherwise blank paper footprint remain. Full raw and complete white/cyan/alpha sheet show no visible garment hole, internal transparency or lost original photo backing; alpha is outside the full card/note silhouette.
